description: Podcast search across the Apple Podcasts directory (iTunes Search API): podcast title, publisher, episode count, genres, latest episode date, explicit flag, RSS feed URL, artwork and Apple Podcasts link, for a search term and optional country store. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_bundlephobia when you need npm package bundle size from Bundlephobia's public size; dev_covers when you need Sportsbook odds from Covers.com odds screens: every listed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: 2-letter Apple store country, e.g. us, gb, de (default us)
